title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: MuleSoft Anypoint
providers.scope_notes: Covers MuleSoft Anypoint Platform. Anypoint Platform control plane (US/EU/Gov); IP allowlist only US/EU commercial; audit export needs Anypoint Integration Advanced or Titanium.

controls.name: Disable connected apps for the organization
controls.what: Org admin can turn off the connected apps feature for the whole org.
controls.setting: Access Management > Connected Apps (exact setting not named in docs)

controls.name: Authorization policy: Restricted (application allowlist)
controls.what: Only allowlisted apps can be authorized by org members; scope additions need re-approval.
controls.setting: Access Management > Connected Apps > authorization policy

controls.name: Disable auto-approval of internal apps
controls.what: Under Restricted, internal apps must also be allowlisted.

controls.name: Revoke Authorization
controls.what: Removes an app's authorization and revokes its access and refresh tokens.
controls.setting: Access Management > Connected Apps > Authorizations > ... > Remove

controls.name: Scopes per business group and environment
controls.what: App permissions are limited to chosen scopes, business groups and environments.
controls.setting: Access Management > Connected Apps > Add Scopes

controls.name: Client secret expiration date
controls.what: Set an expiry on the connected app client secret.

controls.name: Modify the Client Secret for a Connected App
controls.what: Admin replaces the client secret manually or via Access Management API.
controls.setting: Access Management > Connected Apps > app > Secret

controls.name: Delete Connected Application
controls.what: Deleting the app removes the client; effect on live tokens not documented.
controls.setting: Access Management > Connected Apps > Owned Apps

controls.name: Revoke org connected app tokens
controls.what: Revokes all access and refresh tokens issued to a connected app.

Whether a client-credentials app's tokens can be revoked without deleting it (Revoke Authorization is documented for user authorizations)

Whether read/GET API calls are audit logged
Environment client secret rotation procedure (help.salesforce.com KB 001115221 did not render)

auth_paths.name: Connected app that acts on behalf of a user (authorization code, refresh token, password, JWT bearer)

authentication.summary: User authorizes the app (or app uses password or JWT bearer grant) and it gets bearer tokens with the user's permissions limited to app scopes. The password grant precludes MFA; JWT bearer gets tokens without user authorization.

federation.details: JWT bearer grant: app signs an assertion whose sub names identityProviderId and username; trusted-client design, not workload federation.

ip_restriction.boundary: IP allowlist covers interactive sign-ins with Anypoint credentials only; SSO users excluded; token use by the app not documented.

lifetime.summary: Access token tied to user session (~60 min); refresh token 90 days

renewal.expiry_basis: refresh token 90 days; offline_access scope needed
renewal.summary: App exchanges refresh token for new access tokens while user is signed out.

administration.summary: Admins set Unrestricted (default) or Restricted authorization policy; Restricted enables an app allowlist. Internal apps are auto-approved unless that is disabled.
administration.conditions: Allowlist changes do not cut existing authorizations.

inventory.details: Access Management > Connected Apps > Authorizations lists authorized apps; GET /accounts/api/organizations/{organizationId}/connectedApplications lists apps.

network.ui: Access Management > Security Settings > IP Allowlist (add CIDR) > Enforce IP restrictions for login > Save. Covers sign-in with Anypoint credentials only, not SSO or token use

log_sources.name: Anypoint Platform audit log (Access Management > Audit Log, Audit Log Query API)
log_sources.notes: Default retention 1 year (6 years for orgs before 2023-07-10), configurable 30-2190 days; export via Telemetry Exporter needs Anypoint Integration Advanced or Titanium.

credential_id_fields.notes: Object of the entry; payload has clientName, clientIP, orgID, grantTypes
Name of app that performed the action, N/A otherwise

anomaly_cues: Token Retrieval Success from new clientIP
Update Scope Assignments adding broad scopes
Actions attributed to a connected app outside its normal product area
Password or JWT bearer grant used by an app not expected to (grantTypes field)

containment.steps: Access Management > Connected Apps > Authorizations > Remove; also rotate secret.
containment.notes: Docs: access and refresh tokens are revoked; cannot be undone.

incident_response.sample_query: POST /audit/v2/organizations/<orgId>/query with objectIds:["<clientID>"] and a date range

calls.log_notes: Needs Audit Log Viewer or Org Admin

unknown: Which data reads appear in audit log
